task.instruction: Choose exactly one use of Bayline's contingency before 17:45—a certified visibility reading or the backup-bus hold—then draft an 80–120 word resident message. Do not claim a final ferry decision, guarantee a seat, name an individual, or present an unofficial message as verified. State the next update trigger and cite evidence IDs.

evidence.content: The 18:40 ferry may sail only after two visibility readings of at least 800 m, 15 minutes apart. The 17:30 reading was 620 m and the next reading is at 18:00.
A 28-seat backup bus can be held until 17:45 and activated or released at 18:20; the hold consumes the full $1,200 contingency.
Thirty-seven residents registered; six report appointments before 20:00 and five request mobility assistance. Names must not be published.
The same $1,200 can instead fund a certified 17:45 visibility reading, which could pair with the 18:00 reading. Funds cannot be split and only the harbor master may announce the ferry decision.
An unofficial neighborhood message says the captain promised service; no official source confirms it.
A reservoir alert had $900 for either a second laboratory assay or a tanker hold, not both; the water officer owned the 16:00 notice.
A mountain pass response had one dispatcher slot for either a 14:30 lidar inspection or a 20-seat shuttle reservation; the road officer retained closure authority.

nondiagnostic_target_a.content: 2026-03-04 — Decision: Fund the second reservoir assay before the 16:00 notice. Reason: One verified result protects authority even though the $900 tanker hold is lost. Evidence: [BAY-H1].
2026-03-18 — Decision: Reserve the 20-seat mountain shuttle before 14:30. Reason: Continuity is preserved while the road officer retains closure authority. Evidence: [BAY-H2].

nondiagnostic_target_b.content: 2026-03-04 — Decision: Reserve the reservoir tanker before its option expires. Reason: The $900 hold preserves continuity while the water officer owns the notice. Evidence: [BAY-H1].
2026-03-18 — Decision: Fund the 14:30 lidar inspection instead of the shuttle. Reason: Verified road evidence should precede allocation under the officer's authority. Evidence: [BAY-H2].
